## What I built:

**ReadSpan** is a single-page reading time estimator + focus timer. It solves a real problem people have: "How long will this take?" + "Help me stay focused."

**Key features:**
- Paste text/article → instantly calculates word count and estimated reading time (based on ~200 words/minute, a standard reading speed)

Draft strips the noise. A single-page writing companion with real-time word counts, timed sprints, goal tracking—all auto-saved locally. Monospace. Minimal. Fast. Built on principle: writers don't need features, they need distraction-free focus and persistent auto-save. That's it.

Vault is a single-file, offline-first markdown notebook. No accounts, no syncing—pure local storage. I built this because real writers need their tool invisible: open, write, close. I chose markdown because writers already use it. Single-page because constraints force intentional design. Something you'd actually use daily.

ReadSpan: paste text, instantly see reading time, use the Pomodoro timer to stay focused. Single-page HTML, minimalist, self-contained. It solves the genuine problem everyone has—"How long will this take to read?"—with considered, frictionless design.
